status: registered before E3 transformed model outputs; E2 outputs already exposed
question: Does the E2 reader require information from both observation slots, or can a single retained view preserve its association with the original pair labels?
scope: Exploratory mechanism diagnosis on exposed E2 evaluation data, not new held-out confirmation or a new accuracy benchmark.

sampling.population: E2 real_all items with exactly one yes and one no for a given phenomenon/tile; excludes unpaired flood hard negatives
sampling.flood: take first min(8,n) paired tiles per actid, all represented test events
sampling.landslide: take first min(16,n) paired tiles per fold, both exposed regions
sampling.incomplete_or_nonfinite_selected_input: report invalid preparation and stop; do not silently exclude/reselect
sampling.full_E2_cache_audit: CPU check all unique E2 evaluation caches for nonfinite values; report separately without editing E2 outputs
sampling.hard_negatives: Add first min(8,n) unpaired hard-negative items per flood event by the same hash rank, evaluated only in real/later_only/repeat_later; descriptive specificity, not primary paired score.
sampling.primary_subset: paired-positive-tile subset: original yes/no pair from each originally positive tile

inputs.pair: A and B are pooled 64x768 EO tokens using the exact E2 CPU torch avg_pool2d path
inputs.tokens: 192 tokens with types [0]*64+[1]*64+[3]*64 in every arm
inputs.prompt: Identical source E2 prompt and date strings to isolate token interventions and permit real-arm reproduction. Flood date strings remain known imputed values, NOT verified acquisition times.
inputs.frames: Earlier/later names refer to E2 slot order; exact flood acquisition order and spacing were not independently recovered.

arms.earlier_only: [A,0,0]; no hidden later view through difference tokens
arms.later_only: [0,B,0]; no hidden earlier view through difference tokens
arms.reverse: [B,A,A-B]; diagnostic only, original chronological text now conflicts with the intervention

validity.real_reproduction_scope: every seed and phenomenon against complete saved E2 IDs on this subset; reproduce all real arms BEFORE running any interventions
validity.finite: all selected source and pooled arrays, checkpoints and projected tokens finite; generated scores contain no NaN/+Inf and at least one finite value (processor-masked -Inf permitted)
validity.coverage: every prereg item exactly once per seed in its allowed_arms (paired 7 arms; hard_neg real/later_only/repeat_later only), all 3 seeds; ID/input/checkpoint/source/config hashes recorded
validity.failure: invalid run, no scientific verdict; preserve partial output and failure reason; no threshold relaxation

metrics.source_label_balanced_agreement: BA against original pair labels after intervention. This is NOT accuracy against a new transformed-scene gold label.
metrics.primary_unit: flood event macro average: each represented event equally weighted, each tile contributes its yes/no pair
metrics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap of event means (5000 draws, numpy default_rng seed 20260925), resampling events and preserving both source items/arms; report all event values
metrics.delta: intervention source-label BA minus real source-label BA
metrics.secondary: answer agreement with real; yes persistence on original positives answered yes in real; repeated-frame yes rates; no_delta and reverse descriptive outcomes
metrics.landslide: two region means and tile descriptive results only; do not treat tiles as independent unseen regions
metrics.hard_negative_specificity: Original hard negatives are a separate source-label FPR per event and seed; not mixed with the primary equally paired event BA.

flood_decision.single_second_view_sufficient_under_inte: in at least 2/3 seeds, real macro BA >=.60, later_only AND repeat_later macro BA >=.60, and BOTH paired delta CI lower bounds >=-.05 (preregistered noninferiority margin)
flood_decision.history_sensitive_under_intervention: if sufficiency is not met: in at least 2/3 seeds with real macro BA >=.60, BOTH later_only AND repeat_later delta point <=-.10 and paired CI upper <0
flood_decision.mixed_or_inconclusive: otherwise, or fewer than 5 represented flood events
flood_decision.interpretation: Sensitivity to deletion/repetition can be caused by distribution shift and does not prove temporal reasoning. Sufficiency concerns this exposed subset and this frozen reader, not universal irrelevance of history.

no_transformed_gold: Identical or reversed embeddings do not establish that no physical event occurred. No gold=no is assigned to repeat arms. No new pseudo-labels or training are generated in E3.
known_limits: flood pre/pre negative labels are a dataset pre-slot assumption, not independently verified event absence
two phenomena are perfectly confounded with sensor (landslide S2, flood S1); does not establish phenomenon-specific semantics
flood test events were used earlier in Kuro updater research; only disjoint from E2 VLM training
counterfactual repeats/reversal may conflict with unchanged date wording
frozen-reader ablations do not replace retraining an equal-budget single-view model
noninferiority power may be limited; inconclusive does not mean equivalence
fixed small selection may differ from the original tile-weighted full E2 evaluation
Landslide original E2 evaluation is 186 Hiroshima and only 6 Indonesia paired tiles; small second region limits interpretation.

next_step.single_second_view_sufficient_under_inte: Design train-side equal-budget single-view baseline and pair-specific task with verified change labels before memory/temporal claims.
next_step.history_sensitive_under_intervention: Disentangle genuine pair reasoning from input-distribution shift with in-distribution controls and matched single-view training.
next_step.mixed_or_inconclusive: Report per-event/seed effects; identify whether power, low real signal or contradictory mechanisms cause ambiguity before selecting ONE follow-up. Do not repeatedly tune thresholds on these test outputs.
next_step.invalid: Repair input/reproduction implementation with a versioned amendment before any model update.

compute.gpu: 1 only after no other process, with research lock
